Write: "Out-of-Area Tire Repair Reimbursement Under Road Hazard Protection" ("booked as an out-of-area repair reimbursement entry").
- Hop 2 (**state-derived**): that hub's sentence "An out-of-area repair is reimbursed only after the tow of the same breakdown carries its out-of-area tow reimbursement entry on the certificate, and the repair entry is booked under that tow entry's claim number." Records: 214.00 tow charge same day, no OOA tow entry → unmet. Write: "Tows by Outside Operators: Road Hazard Protection Reimbursement".
- Order: tow → repair → authorisation. Leaves agent writes; root customer write.
- Counter-proof "only replace": authorising now fixes the share while a claimable outside repair of LF lacks its entry (forbidden by the hub sentence); numerically LF would show 3 covered repairs → shortened period 3 months (to 2026-10-25) → 100% if L ≤ 14. "Repair before tow" is excluded by the repair hub sentence. No hop pre-solved (no tool name/route beside the sentences; the "booked under that tow entry's claim number" clause names an entry, not a tool).
- Alternatives excluded: Buckhannon repair already carries entry RHC-2387298; tow on new claim (latest entry is a roadside dispatch within 30 days); tender Crestline Mastercard (paid "to the tender the certificate was bought with" = fleet_account); national-file tiers (Starter = posted price).
